result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection with minimal pedestrian infrastructure. While a marked crosswalk is visible on one leg, the environment is dominated by high-speed vehicle traffic and lacks continuous, well-connected sidewalks.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The extreme width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to traffic for a long duration without any mid-crossing refuge.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left appears to terminate or transition into grass, creating an incomplete pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages, reducing exposure time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder style markings to all legs of the intersection to improve visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Extend and connect the sidewalk network to ensure a continuous paved path for pedestrians through the intersection.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed, multi-lane arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk but minimal supporting pedestrian infrastructure. The environment is heavily car-oriented, characterized by long crossing distances and a lack of visible sidewalks or pedestrian refuge islands at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk or clear landing area at the end of the crosswalk, forcing pedestrians onto grass or the roadway shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the terminus of the crosswalk

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crossing area could present a trip hazard.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a continuous and accessible pedestrian network.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals and ensure they are timed to provide adequate crossing intervals for all users.
